title: Millennials lead AI shopping adoption in India at 84%, ahead of Gen Z: McKinsey
description: Millennials are leading the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) for shopping in India, with 84 per cent using AI-powered tools to search for products, compare options or make purchase decisions, ahead of 74 per cent of Gen Z consumers, according to a report by McKinsey & Company.

title: Millennials Lead India in AI Shopping Adoption McKinsey Report Finds
description: Millennials in India are leading the adoption of AI-powered shopping tools, with 84% usage, surpassing Gen Z and other generations, according to a recent McKinsey & Company survey across 11 global markets.
